scope: All 1,058 official directory rows, not just map-visible or VS-linked buildings. Codes are not unique; officialId is the key.
purpose: Feasibility scan for 10 display icon groups, not authoritative historical-use research or production categorization.
policy: Classify the site's documented Republican-era use (1912–1949), not necessarily the original use of the standing listed building.
Confirmed same-site predecessors may supply an earlier use even if the standing building was constructed after 1949.
Name-based categories are candidates, not verified Republican-era histories; source original-name fields may contain modern tenants.
An era classification does not establish use in 1928 or throughout 1912–1949. Retain phase changes and component scope.
Museum→education; guild hall→commerce; military→public; cemetery→parks as display groups only.
Nearby display links do not prove site identity and never supply inherited use.
Unknown remains a research state, not an eleventh icon category; do not invent an era function to fill a category.
snapshotFormat: Compact candidate audit; run audit-heritage-display-categories.mjs for detailed input/link evidence. Not imported by the app.
